items.note: B1 states the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch, and B1.1-B1.3 follow the proof (old scratch cancelled, net map JV+RG, three stages). The neighbour rules (|S∩T|=1 bit, even intersection complex) and the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 (752-758) are not given, only 'the intersection-count coefficient', and the wire counts W_b, W_c (777-781) are absent.

The invariant (stored = D_v·logical), commutation of the common frame with the pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator on every role, auxiliary roles included, all follow lines 804-825.

Labels, terminal labels, stage transitions, the only decrease (centre 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, the telescoping to Wm-2N and the absolute total Wm-2N+2L are all present, and L_b/N=100/539 is given. The edge-by-edge residual table (1021-1064) that verifies every other edge is nondecreasing appears only as a method phrase, and the binary orthonormal-basis argument (1073-1102) and L_c/N=101/539 are absent.

It has the P_V-P_U rank argument, the N exceptional source edges of matrix 2P_{U_a}, s_b=Wm-N+2L with deficit N-2L>0, the frames Phi_M, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, all as in the paper's proof.

Weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, the odd-weight basis vectors giving aI+bX_v or its inverse, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c, the 27-coordinate correction by C=iZC^{-1}Z, and C^{⊗m} on every role and on k columns all follow lines 1231-1314.

It has L<N/2, the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, eta>20·2^{-50}, m<2^20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. The exact eta values (1322-1324) are not quoted, but the inequality used is.

A1 and A2 restate the two lemmas faithfully. A's one-line method (split, pointwise map, merge) does not reconstruct the proofs at 513-550 and 574-639. A2 omits that q is a fixed prime with denominators prime to q.

The shear proof is reconstructed: triangular factors as descending controlled shifts, the E_1,E_2 sandwich, and one interchange per one of Pi via D+=H, swap, D=H-D. The pivot-elimination proof of the factorization (1376-1391) and the choice of the fixed prime q avoiding denominators (1413-1423) are missing.

It follows the proof step by step: the k=0 base, the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on edges by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the parking-stack schedule.
High digits as a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, zero-row padding R'<2R, base-m pieces with sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and binary-to-[q^e] padding all match 1649-1734.

Conjugation by P_M with P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv}, P_M as a fixed number of row additions, the inverse child via (-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D all match the paper.

It has the eight parity-tested shifts restoring the auxiliary integer, the guard bad set with twenty excluded values per guard and delta_bad, the fact that T_0S_0^{-1} permutes B, and the extract/radix-sort/reinsert repair, as in the proof. The chunk-swap realisation of each rotation (2117-2155), the source of the L^tau cost, is only implicit, and the full time bound with the MA^3 terms is not stated.

The recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), the 1/W child volume and the final O(d^{lambda'}) are stated. Missing are where the rows come from (the first q_0=O(log d) chunks as row index, 2306-2323), the node-overhead derivation from packed additions, and the unrolling via K<=e^{c/beta} with internal and leaf sums (2413-2430).

It states Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error <sqrt2·2^{-p}, the reduction to s_c children of volume 1/W_c, and exact arithmetic with guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p). The guard-width derivation (depth recursion, 2450-2586) and the uniformity check of the packed-call costs (2696-2735) are not reconstructed.

Contraction, character cancellation without dividing by omega^j-1, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage B_tF_t^- and its opposite, the layout L from prefix moves and chunk exchanges, the three cost terms and the error sqrt2·l·2^{-p} all match.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2 for centred residues, negacyclic wrap, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost follow the proof.
Retained LB order, F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), the commutation of pointwise product with LB, and the error M(3delta+eta) are all present. F2.4's account of the third delta is loose (see errors).

The exact identity is derived as in the paper: Gaussian identity, ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}, Neumann inversion, normalisations giving 2^{-2alpha^2}, and the tensor form. The numerical approximation algorithms behind error <p^2 and time O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha) (3644-3792) are not reconstructed, and P_s,P_t are never defined explicitly.

It has the chirp identity, the coefficient check, the dilation identity RF^+R=F^+ and the two normalizations. The step that R commutes with the pointwise product, (RFu)·(RFv)=R(Fu·Fv) (3962-3964), which lets R cancel, is left out. Conservatively partial.

Fixed exponents, sizes, axis lengths, the prime interval with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, deterministic search and no wraparound all match. The choice alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}), gamma=2d alpha^2 with gamma=o(b) (gamma<=b/4, 4089-4101), which exact recovery needs, is missing, as are delta=1/16 and beta.
It has the isomorphism by order S, the triangular mixed-radix formula, padding preserved, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and the O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) cost, as in the paper.

The exact twist isomorphism, the wrap check and the cost are given. The interface M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T and the computed-twist sequence with its error terms (4362-4413) are not reconstructed.
Chirp construction, the computed chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart RF_s, conjugation for RF_s^+, and the six steps with the two occurrences of S all match.
It chains E_ring<5TL, E_s=9·2^gamma TL, E_w<28·2^gamma T^2 L, the final error 448b·2^{-b+gamma}<1/2, rounding and the carry bound as in the paper.
All seven table rows, the margins g_1..g_7, min=2^{-181}=2kappa, the o(Tp) setup and the final O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) are reproduced. The schoolbook cutoff is not mentioned.
No step discusses the n log n conjecture, the eventual lower bound or the liminf; R only states the upper bound.

errors.says: The two forward errors delta propagate through the bilinear product to 2delta, the truncation adds eta and the opposite transform is a contraction, so the error is below M(3delta+eta).
errors.paper: The third delta is the opposite procedure's own approximation error, ||h~ - T_+ z~|| < delta; contraction only keeps 2delta+eta from growing (lines 3463-3470). As worded, the plan's account sums to 2delta+eta, not 3delta+eta.

errors.says: Labels are built from 'tensor cubes of indicator vectors of three-element subsets'.
errors.paper: u_a=t_{a_1}⊗t_{a_2}⊗t_{a_3} is a tensor product of the indicators of three generally different triples, not the cube of one vector.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: scalar exchange network, frames, labels, then s<Wm and tau, then the interchange recurrence and arbitrary-width interchange, then the phase network, packed additions and the simultaneous layer, then synthetic transforms, convolution, resampling, CRT, recovery and the cost table. The movement branch (B through C) is fully reconstructed. The chain thins in the butterfly-layer recurrence (row construction and unrolling only stated), in the guard-width and Gaussian numerical-map derivations, and in the omitted gamma=o(b) choice that exact recovery relies on. None of these breaks the logical chain.

steps.note: It has the fixed linear network, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) in three stages with every scratch wire restored, and three-element subsets of [100]. N=binom(100,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given explicitly (m only as the dimension of F^{⊗3}), so this is reconstructed in mechanism and thin on quantities.
The common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, giving D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge applies only D_vD_u^{-1}.
It has nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3}, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreases at centre 3->4, each losing h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, with the N source edges (matrix 2P_{U_a}) as the rank-one exceptions.
It has the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=Wm-N+2L after adding the N source ranks.
L_b/N=100/539<1/2 gives N-2L>0 and s<Wm. The complex ratio 101/539 is not given, though the complex deficit 2N-2L_c>0 is.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m via P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, so the network applies H<-H+D on every role.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta>20·2^{-50} and m<2^20 giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, so F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine links of the central saving are present with their defining content, from the bank-exchange network through frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity and the rank-to-interchange factorization, to the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only thinness is that N and m are never given numerically and the complex loss ratio 101/539 is omitted.
